name: Gemini
description: Google's AI assistant for help with information, creative tasks and productivity.
longDescription: Gemini is Google's family of AI models and assistant experiences. Features and availability depend on product, plan and region.
benefits: Works within Google's AI product ecosystem
limitations: Features vary by region and account

articleContent.introduction: Gemini is Google's AI assistant experience.
articleContent.overview: It brings Google's AI capabilities into conversational and productivity workflows.
articleContent.howItWorks: Users interact through prompts and supported input types; exact capabilities depend on the current product offering.

faqs.a: Yes, Gemini is Google's AI product family.
